The House Committee on Energy, Utilities Bill 641 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Lim of the 98th, Mathiak of the 82nd, Werkheiser of the 157th, Drenner of the 85th, Lupton of the 83rd, and Telecommunications offers the following substitute to HB 641: others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 3 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to electric services, so as to require certain electric suppliers to have in place a written … electric service to residential consumers with serious, life-threatening conditions, and shall furnish such written policy upon request by a consumer or potential consumer."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
